gloss: to exaggerate a story; to embellish; to add embellishments

definitions.gloss: to exaggerate a story; to add embellishments; to dramatize
definitions.explanation: Idiom literally meaning 'to attach a tail and fins'. Used when a story or rumour gets enlarged each time it's passed along, with details added that were not in the original.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{尾|お}ひれをつける。
⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{尾|お}ひれ→尾ひれ：24576_ohire⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦{広|ひろ}まった→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧。
examples.english: The rumour spread, growing more embellished as it went.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{人|ひと}づて⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いている→聞く：00483_kiku⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧⟦{尾|お}ひれ→尾ひれ：24576_ohire⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: By the time the story had passed through several people, it was thoroughly embellished.

notes:
Idiom of unclear origin — likely from depicting a creature growing extra tail and fins over time. Negative connotation: implies the added details are exaggerations, not improvements.

COMMON FORMS:
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{尾|お}ひれをつける: to add embellishments to a story (active, transitive)
- ⟦{尾|お}ひれがつく→尾ひれがつく：21978_ohiregatsuku⟧: (the story) gets embellishments added (intransitive — used of the rumour itself)
- {尾|お}ひれをつけて⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to tell with embellishments

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誇張|こちょう}する→誇張する：22148_kochousuru⟧: to exaggerate — neutral and direct, no metaphor
- {大袈裟|おおげさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say in an exaggerated way — focuses on the manner of telling
- ⟦{脚色|きゃくしょく}→脚色：18162_kyakushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dramatize; to spice up — often used of news or anecdotes
